Name: Unlimited Chest Colors
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
Hi it's me again, the modder who made a colour picker she's proud of and wants to get as much use out of it as she can. I've now modified the chest menu to use my colour picker instead of the row of preset colours along the top. This means that instead of choosing from 1 of 20 different colours for your chests, you can choose whatever colour you want instead. As long as that colour can be found on a standard colour wheel. Y'know, has a hex code and stuff. The menu also comes with the 20 usual colours built into the palette for easy selection though, if you still like them or want to match existing chests.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Can I add this mod mid-save?[/size][/b]
Yes.

[b][size=4]Can I remove this mod mid-save?[/size][/b]
Yes. Your chests will remain the last colour you chose for them though, they won't return to the ordinary colours. But you can just change them again through the vanilla colour picker.

[b][size=4]How do I reset the colour of my chests?[/size][/b]
Hold Left Shift or Left Trigger (if you're on controller) when in the chest menu and the colour picker button will change to a "reset chest colour" button. Click it to remove the colour from your chest.

[b][size=4]Does this have controller support?[/size][/b]
Yes, controllers are fully supported in this colour picker menu.
